tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the FGD catalogue: fonts (display, retro, brush, handwritten, geometric, free), the 6 font bundle, design assets (mockups, icons, patterns, image packs) and live 3D mockups. Returns name, type, price, a short description, a preview image and links. Leave query empty to list everything of a ty

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Full details of one font, the bundle, an asset or a mockup by id (from search_catalog): description, styles, formats, languages, what is included, best uses, preview images, licence summary, price, page_url and checkout_url.

tools.name: get_licence
tools.description: What the FGD licence allows for fonts and assets (personal, commercial, web, apps, logos, merchandise), what is not allowed, and the refund rule.

tools.name: mockup_link
tools.description: A link to the free in-browser 3D mockup editor on a product and scene, with a preview image. The person drops in their design, turns it, changes light and scene, animates it, and exports a free 1080 px image, or a 4K image or MP4 video for $3.
